answer: Make every agent post a ferrous stake, locked collateral that is slashed on proven misbehavior, before it can trade. New identities start at the wharf with zero reputation and must complete a voyage of small attested jobs, each verified by established peers, before earning access to larger payments. A sybil operator can mint a thousand names, but each needs its own stake and its own voyage, so forging an army costs linearly while honest agents amortize one stake across years of work.
